abstract:
BACKGROUND: Patients with intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms have an increased risk of developing concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Krüppel-like factor 4 regulates p21 expression and has been implicated in intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm tumorigenesis. We investigated the Krüppel-like factor 4-p21 pathway in intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms associated with concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 106 patients who underwent pancreatic resection for intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm or concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma associated with intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm between 2018 and 2025. The immunohistochemical expression of Krüppel-like factor 4 and p21 was quantitatively evaluated using H-scores, whereas p53 expression was assessed by positive or negative staining. Associations between clinicopathologic features and concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma status were assessed. PANC-1 cells were transfected with wild-type or K409Q-mutant Krüppel-like factor 4 to assess the effect of the K409Q mutation on p21 expression.
RESULTS: Krüppel-like factor 4-K409Q retained p21-inducing ability despite lower protein expression than wild-type Krüppel-like factor 4. Of the 106 patients, 20 had concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, and Krüppel-like factor 4 expression did not differ between intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms with and without concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (median H-score, 26.1 vs 21.1; P = .151), whereas p21 expression was lower in intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms with concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (8.6 vs 21.9; P = .020). Krüppel-like factor 4 and p21 expression showed a significant positive correlation with intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm tissue (r = 0.516; P < .001). Comparison among intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm without concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm regions from concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cases, and concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma regions demonstrated reduced p21 expression in intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm regions from concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cases (P = .049). The frequency of p53-positive staining did not differ between intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms with and without concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (P = .56).
CONCLUSION: Dysregulation of the Krüppel-like factor 4-p21 axis may contribute to pancreatic carcinogenesis, independent of detectable changes in p53 expression.
key_points_ko: 총 106명의 환자 중 20명에서 동반 췌관선암(PDAC)이 관찰되었습니다.
p21 발현 수준(H-score)은 동반 췌관선암이 있는 IPMN 그룹(8.6)이 동반 췌관선암이 없는 그룹(21.9)보다 유의하게 낮았습니다(P = .020).
IPMN 조직에서 KLF4와 p21 발현은 유의한 양의 상관관계(r = 0.516, P < .001)를 나타냈습니다.
p53 양성 염색 빈도는 동반 췌관선암 유무에 따른 IPMN 그룹 간 유의한 차이가 없었습니다(P = .56).
summary_ko: 본 연구는 췌관 내 유두상 점액 종양(IPMN) 및 IPMN 동반 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자 106명의 절제 조직을 바탕으로 KLF4-p21 경로를 분석했습니다. 분석 결과, 동반 췌관선암이 있는 IPMN 조직은 동반 췌관선암이 없는 IPMN 조직에 비해 p21 발현이 유의하게 낮았습니다. IPMN 조직 내에서 Krüppel-유사 인자 4(KLF4)와 p21 발현은 양의 상관관계를 보였습니다. 연구진은 p53 변이와 무관하게 KLF4-p21 축의 조절 이상이 췌장 암화 과정에 기여할 수 있음을 확인했습니다.
title: Dysregulation of the KLF4-p21 axis in intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms associated with concomitant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
title_ko: 동반 췌관선암이 존재하는 췌관 내 유두상 점액 종양에서의 KLF4-p21 축 조절 이상
